name: ActiveCampaign
description: Advanced marketing automation, customer segmentation, and visual workflow builder for scaling e-commerce brands.
fullDescription: ActiveCampaign offers industry-leading marketing automation and CRM capabilities. It allows 7- and 8-figure e-commerce brands to build intricate condition-based customer journeys, sync purchase history from multiple storefronts, and trigger timely repurchase reminders based on individual consumption cycles.
features: Over 900+ pre-built marketing and customer journey automation recipes
Deep Shopify and WooCommerce purchase history sync with RFM analysis
Conditional content logic allowing personalized product recommendations
Built-in CRM with deal tracking, automated sales stages, and win probability
Comprehensive attribution modeling to measure exact campaign ROI
